title: MS Office Product Activation Issues (Official Dell Tech Support).mp4
description: Watch this video MS Office Product Activation Issues if you can't find the MS Office installation that was purchased with your Dell computer, follow these instructions to install MS Office, and redeem the Office product bought together with your PC purchase; more than likely Microsoft has removed that version of Office before the first time activation and in this video we show you what you can do. To learn more about our Dell Community Forum check out http://dell.to/2tbhVvt  For additional guidance with your PC's maintenance and troubleshooting visit http://dell.to/2te92S1

asr.full_text: If you can't find the Microsoft Office installation that was purchased with your Dell computer, luckily it's not too difficult to get it. More than likely Microsoft has removed that version of Office before the first time activation. If you purchased Microsoft office together with your Dell computer as a bundled transaction, be sure to double check the order line items in your purchase order email from Dell. The internal product description DFO reflects that it is a digitally fulfilled Office product. Additionally, any office product orders placed after December 15, 2016 will adhere to the digital delivery process. If your purchase meets both of these criteria and you cannot find the installation then use the setup link for your region as provided in the video description to download Microsoft Office once you have the download you will need to run Microsoft activation easy fix the link for this program is also in the description this process will modify the registry keys which will allow Office to read the proper registry settings so it can be updated. Be sure to have windows activated and that you have internet access. Then open any Office application or program to start the Office Setup Wizard. When the dialog box Let's Get Started appears, follow the prompts to activate Office as usual However you may actually see the Office activated in a different version than the one that was originally purchased. If this is the case, you must run the Office Update through the Microsoft Office menu. To do this, select Account, then click on Office Updates. Once the update is completed, Office will show the correct version after the system restarts. If for some reason you are not able to download and apply the Easy Fix, then you should refer to the Microsoft Office Support page and follow the manual Modify Registry Keys procedure. The link for the Microsoft Office Support Page can also be found in the description. If you need further assistance or have any questions, contact us through social media on Facebook or Twitter, or join in the chat on the Dell Community Forum! Be sure to check our other videos on this channel and if you liked this video, give it a Like and don't forget to Subscribe. Thanks for watching!
